notes.title: Anniversary update!
notes.notes:
Anniversary update!

FoxyLand game celebrates its anniversary!
New levels with new mechanics are waiting for you!
Also added new languages!
New gamepad support. Now it is even more convenient to choose levels in the menu!
Removed bugs and defects.

The team of Or Monkey Studio together with BUG-Studio wants to thank all the players who played our game and left positive feedback.
We love You!


Update 1.6.0 :
- New Gamepad Support!
- Added new languages( German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese)
- Added 9 new levels!
- Bug fix.

notes.title: Multiplayer!🦊🍒
notes.notes:
[b]At the moment we are working on a new game mode.[/b]
This mode will be called "Online" where you connect to a random player.
Online mode - complete the level faster than the opponent. 
Before the round You make the "bet" cherries, from 10 to 1000 cherries per round. If you win you get X2 your bet cherry. If you lose, you will lose your bet.

The update will be released soon and will have cross-platform multiplayer.🦊🍒

[img]http://tecengod.net/gif_53.gif[/img]
